text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi Press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three new bills are ready for tabling in the National Assembly when the house meets from March 5 during the 1997/98 budget session.

- Press Corp Ltd trustees appointed by government to take over from ex-president Kamuzu Banda's Malawi Congress Party (MCP) trustees are accusing their predecessors of misappropriating funds of the company, the country's biggest conglomerate.
- The Forum for National Conscience, a pro-opposition organisation, has asked President Bakili Muluzi to dismiss six cabinet ministers he appointed from the opposition Alliance for Democracy (AFORD).

- The opposition MCP and AFORD will on Thursday meet the ruling United Democratic Front in tripartite talks aimed at solving the controversay surrounding six cabinet ministers appointed from the opposition against the party's will.
